field_hint: Select a value to adjust. Tab moves between fields; ↑↓ changes the value.
game_invalid_image: The image address or format could not be read. Other fields remain editable.
layout_scope: Applies to this window only; ROM pointers stay unchanged. Address and record size must be aligned to 4 bytes.
move_table_scope: Copy the automatically located table and update confirmed references. The original data stays in place. Apply creates one undoable edit; save writes the file.
space_invalid_range: The declared free space is invalid or overlaps protected data. No changes were applied.
space_no_capacity: This operation would exceed the 32 MiB ROM limit.
space_invalid_reference: A confirmed reference no longer points to the source, or no reference could be confirmed. No changes were applied.
invalid_address: Enter a hexadecimal ROM offset or a GBA ROM address starting with 08 or 09.
batch_scope: Choose a field and preview the changes before applying them to the records below. Changing the search clears selection.
hex_scope: Read a byte range, then apply the edited bytes to the in-memory ROM as one undoable operation. Save to write the file.
invalid_hex: Enter two hex digits per byte, separated by spaces or newlines. The byte count must match the range read.
raw_length: Read between 1 and 4096 bytes at a time.
raw_read_first: Read the chosen address and length before applying edits.
raw_stale: The ROM changed. Your draft is preserved; copy any edits you need and read the range again before applying.
no_emulator: mGBA was not found. Install an emulator or set FEBUILDER_EMULATOR to its executable path.
empty_detail: Open an FE6, FE7J, FE7U, FE8J, or FE8U ROM from the File menu. Each file opens in its own window.
name: Name
name_edit_scope: English ROMs use ASCII; Japanese ROMs use Shift-JIS. Characters must be supported by this ROM.
name_needs_id: Choose an existing nonzero name text ID before editing its text.
text_edit_summary: Text ID {textID}: all uses of this ID will change. Known name, description and use-description fields: {count}.
game_invalid_name_encoding: This name cannot be encoded with the ROM's character encoding and Huffman tree. Use supported characters without leading or trailing spaces; game text must fit 4096 bytes.
description_edit_scope: English ROMs use ASCII; Japanese ROMs use Shift-JIS. A standalone [0x001F] pads English text; it is not visible text. Keep control markers and arguments unchanged and in order. Escape literal [ and backslash as \[ and \\.
text_read_only: This text contains characters that cannot be decoded losslessly, unsupported controls or incomplete arguments and is read-only.
game_invalid_text_encoding: This text cannot be encoded losslessly. Keep the original control markers and their order; use characters and newlines supported by the ROM. Game text must fit 4096 bytes.
game_invalid_text: The text entry or Huffman tree is invalid. Writing requires a valid primary text-table pointer.
external: The ROM changed on disk. Reload it or save as another file.
text_error: The name could not be decoded; its text ID remains editable.
run_saved: Save your changes before starting the emulator.
error: The operation failed. See the details.
game_unsupported_version: This version supports FE6, FE7J, FE7U, FE8J, and FE8U. Choose a valid ROM for one of these games.
game_invalid_layout: This table's location or extent could not be determined. Other tables remain available.
game_invalid_value: The value is outside this field's range.
game_invalid_field: The record or field could not be found.
rom_range: The edits are out of range or overlap. No changes were applied.
rom_stale_edit: The document changed. Read the data again or select the record before editing.
rom_external_change: The file changed on disk. Reload it or save as another file.
rom_target_exists: The target exists. Choose another path or confirm replacement.
rom_read_only: The file is read-only. Save it to a writable location.
rom_invalid_size: Invalid file size. A ROM must be a regular file of at most 32 MiB.
batch_title: Batch edit — {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}
